g.text: Code the future. Lead with purpose.
The College of Information and Computer Studies of De La Salle
University-Dasmariñas, where Lasallian values meet tomorrow's
CICS is DLSU-D's home for technology education, built on
academic excellence, innovation and strong ethics.
Students, faculty and industry partners work together on real
technological problems. Through its Computer Science and Information
Technology departments, the college prepares future leaders who make
meaningful contributions to the digital world.
Read the full mission and vision →
